title: feat(app-shell): the action result dialog draws table answer fields, and Import Users shows its result per row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi99ewj5JRWXTB3u38E9HLhnj)_

Part of #33187. This PR draws the per-row import result. One part stays open: the Add User result still does not say that an email-only re-add was already pending. The renderer contract cannot hide a `false` row on a fresh add, so that half moves to #34651 (see Acceptance notes).

Clause-②: yes (widening)
Metadata-protocol: none
Skills-docs: follow-up #34648
Ruling-ref: 6915677641

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：控制台的动作结果弹窗和预读面板现在能画 `table` 格式，按列逐行显示；托管环境「设置 → 用户 → 导入用户」的结果从一大块 JSON 变成逐行表格（邮箱、是否成功、是否已待激活、是否已通知托管方及原因、未添加原因、未生效的列、上级未关联）。
- 为什么改：您在本卡选了 A（记录 6915677641）；spec 半边（#34500）已落地，这是渲染半边。
- 风险与回滚：只加不减。其他五种格式照旧；唯一行为变化是 `code-list` 只在值为字符串数组时按代码列表画，否则画 JSON（契约本来就这么写）。回滚即撤本 PR。
- 先看：`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionResultDialog.tsx`（`TableBlock` / `TableCellValue`，`null` 画空格；`ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` 的 `columns` 类型从契约派生）、`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`（导入结果的列）、`packages/spec/liveness/action.json`（`columns` 转 live）。
- 两分钟验证：`cd ui && pnpm exec vitest run packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/ActionResultDialog.test.tsx`，预期 25 例全绿。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 改了 `packages/spec/src` 的描述文字，席位会请您批一次。「加用户」重加一个待激活的人时仍不显示「已待激活」，已另立 #34651（排在 PR #34531 之后）。

## What changes

- **Console renderer** (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/ActionResultDialog.tsx`). `ResultField` gains a `table` branch, following the `table` bullet of the `resultDialog` renderer contract in `packages/spec/src/ui/action.zod.ts`:
  - an array value draws as a table, one row per element and one cell per entry of `columns`, in order; the header is the column's `label` (an inline locale map is resolved), falling back to its `path`;
  - a cell reads the column's dot `path` in the element; a missing key and a `null` both draw an empty cell, never the text `null` (renderer note 1 of 6934494528);
  - a present value draws in the column's `format` (omitted: `text`) when it fits it (`qrcode` / `secret` / `text` a string, `code-list` an array of strings); any other value, and every `json` cell, draws as one line of JSON;
  - an element that is not a plain object (an array, `null`, a scalar) draws as compact JSON in its row's first cell, the other cells empty;
  - `[]` draws the header over the existing `table.noRows` line ("No rows to display"); no new UI string, so no `@object-ui/i18n` pack is touched;
  - a value that is not an array draws as `json`; a missing value is skipped, as for any field.
  The dialog widens from `max-w-lg` to `max-w-3xl` when it draws a table. The preflight panel draws its `fields` through the same exported `ResultField` (`ActionParamDialog.tsx#PreflightPanel`), so `preflight.fields` gets the table with no further change.
- **`@object-ui/core` (r2, review nit N2).** `ResultDialogFieldSpec` in `ui/packages/core/src/actions/ActionRunner.ts` gains `columns?: SpecResultDialogField['columns']`, derived from the contract row as its `label` and `format` already are; no hand-written copy. The renderer now reads `columns` off the runner's own type, so its local intersection type is gone and the test casts (`as never`) are dropped.
- **`code-list` fit test** (renderer note 2). The field-level fit test is now the contract's: an array of strings. Before, any array drew as a code list. One shared `valueFitsFormat` serves the field and the cell.
- **`sys_user.import_sso_users`** (`packages/platform-objects/src/identity/sys-user.object.ts`). The `rows` field changes from `json` to `table`. Its columns are read off the door's row answer (`ImportSsoUserRowResult` in `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/pending-sso-users.ts`, unchanged): Row, Email, Succeeded (`ok`), Already pending, told again (`alreadyPending`), Hosting organization told (`host.notified`), Why not told (`host.reason`), Not added because (`error.message`), Not applied (`notApplied`, a code list) and Manager (`managerError`). The three summary counts are unchanged.
- **Spec wrap-up** (prose and ledger only; no key, format value or refusal changes):
  - `columns`' describe loses `[PLANNED — not yet rendered]` and the "draws its label alone" sentence; the field `format` describe loses the marker too;
  - N3: the `table` bullet now says "not a plain object (an array, `null` or a scalar)";
  - the bullet and the column `format` describe now say that a `null` cell value draws an empty cell. This writes renderer note 1 into the contract, so the renderer and the text agree. It goes one sentence past the delta's list, and the contract review should read it;
  - (r2, S1 of the contract review 6939815806) the `table` bullet and the column `format` describe now say that inside a cell `text` and `code-list` draw the value alone with no copy control, while `secret` keeps its mask, reveal and copy and `qrcode` keeps its code and copy. Prose only: no key, value or behaviour moves;
  - `packages/spec/liveness/action.json`: `preflight.fields.columns` and its three children go `planned` → `live`, with evidence anchored on `ResultField`, `TableBlock`, `TableCellValue` and `PreflightPanel`. The `resultDialog` row's note is updated, and `liveness/state-counts/action.md` is regenerated (live 79 → 82, planned 5 → 2).
- **Docs (r2)**: `content/docs/protocol/objectui/actions.mdx` lists `table` among the answer-field formats, with its `columns` and the refusals, in the contract's wording (the item both #34500 contract records left to the renderer half).
- **Changeset**: `.changeset/33187-action-answer-table-renderer.md`, patch for `@object-ui/app-shell`, `@object-ui/core`, `@objectstack/platform-objects` and `@objectstack/spec`.

## Tests

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/__tests__/ActionResultDialog.test.tsx` has two new top-level `describe`s in the shared harness, 13 cases. They cover: the header (label, else path) and column order; one row per element, read at each path; the empty cell for a missing key and for `null`; a misfit value drawn as compact JSON (a boolean under `text`, an object, a non-string array under `code-list`, a number under `secret`); a `secret` cell staying masked; a non-plain-object element (array, `null`, string, number) in the first cell; `[]` drawn as header plus empty line; a non-array value drawn as `json`; a missing `table` field skipped; an inline locale-map column label; the preflight path through `ResultField`; and the `code-list` string-array fit with its CONTROL. The 12 existing cases are the CONTROL for the five formats. They pass unchanged.
- `packages/platform-objects/src/identity/cloud-managed-visibility.test.ts` has a new top-level `describe` (2 cases): `rows` is a `table` whose column paths are the door's row members, in order, and the summary fields stay as they were (CONTROL).
- (r2) `ui/packages/core/src/actions/__tests__/ActionRunner.resultDialog.test.ts` has a new top-level `describe` with compile-time pins, compiled by the package's `tsconfig.test.json` (chained off `type-check`): `ResultDialogFieldSpec['columns']` is structurally `Equal` to the contract row's `columns`, is not `any`, and is optional.
- No existing assertion changed.

## Acceptance notes

- **Add User `alreadyPending` (the owed should-fix) is not delivered here, so this PR says `Part of`.** The door answers `alreadyPending: false` on every fresh add (`runAddSsoUser`). The dialog skips only a path that resolves to `undefined`, and a boolean fits no format, so it would draw as `false`. A field reading `alreadyPending` would therefore draw the misleading "false" row on every fresh add that ruling A turned down (option C). The contract offers no condition on a field. The seat chose the door route (a key present only on a re-add, widening only): it is #34651, sequenced after PR #34531, together with the real-answer alignment pin.
- **The #33186 changeset sentence cannot be corrected in this changeset.** `.changeset/33186-managed-add-people-actions.md` has been released. It shipped in `@objectstack/platform-objects` 18.5.0 (entry `2e1e3b9`, `packages/platform-objects/CHANGELOG.md`), and #34042 removed it from `.changeset/`. Under AGENTS.md (Documentation Guardrails, `CHANGELOG.md` row), a released entry is amended in a dedicated docs-only PR, never by an erratum in a later changeset. The sentence becomes true when #34651 lands; that card's Done when carries the docs-only fallback.
- **Column headers are not translated from bundles.** The i18n extractor (`packages/lint/src/i18n-walk.ts`) keys `resultDialog.fields.PATH` to a field's label alone, and the console overlay keys the same way, so a column `label` gets no bundle key. The import table's headers are therefore English in every locale. The field label "Result per row" above the table is still translated. Filed as #34652 (a bundle-key convention for column labels).
- **Cell chrome.** In a cell, `text` and `code-list` draw the value alone, with no per-cell copy button, because a 500-row import with a copy button in every cell is unusable. `secret` keeps its mask, reveal and copy, and `qrcode` keeps its code and copy. Since r2 the contract says so in the `table` bullet and the column `format` describe (S1).
- **Known limitation: `readPath` reads inherited members (review nit N1).** The dot-path reader is plain property lookup, shared by fields and cells, so a path naming a member the value does not own (`constructor`, `toString`, `email.length`) resolves to it rather than to nothing. It predates this PR, the field-level read on `main` behaves the same, and no declared path reaches it. Not changed here.
- **Booleans draw as `true` / `false`.** No format draws a boolean any other way, so Succeeded, Already pending and Hosting organization told show `true` / `false`. This is the table-wide status that ruling A accepted, not a stray `false` row.
- **The alignment pin does not use a real door answer.** Only `plugin-auth`'s `pending-sso-users.test.ts` can produce one while also reading the `sys_user` declaration, and this run may not edit `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/**`. So the platform-objects pin holds the column paths, the renderer pins use a sample in the door's documented row shape, and the real-answer pin rides with #34651.
- **Skills text.** The `skills/objectstack-ui/rules/actions.md` sentence for `resultDialog` / `table` is governed (Tier H) and goes in #34648, after this lands.
- No `ui/packages/i18n` change, so the `git merge-tree` check against PR #34531 does not apply.

## Verification

- A1, `table` branch removed (`format === 'table'` returns `json`): 9 failed, 16 passed.
- A2, `null` handling removed (only `undefined` draws empty): 1 failed, the `null` empty-cell case.
- A3, `code-list` fit reverted to `Array.isArray`: 2 failed, the misfit-cell case and the field-level non-string array case.

Each leg restored: the blob after restore equals HEAD (`eea0d1ad0638`), and `git diff HEAD` is empty.

</details>
